BASE_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-4B"

DEVICE = "cuda:0"
N_SAMPLES = 100
N_WARMUP = 5
MAX_SEQ_LENGTH = 4096
MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 512

# Prompts (from eval scripts)
CLS_SYSTEM = "You are a code verifier. Given a code patch (git diff) and a test name, predict whether the test will pass or fail when run against the patched code."
CLS_USER_TMPL = "## Patch (git diff)\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\nWill this test pass or fail?"

CWM_SYSTEM = "You are a code execution simulator. Given a code patch (git diff) and a test name, predict the execution result when the test is run against the patched code."
CWM_USER_TMPL = "## Patch (git diff)\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\nWhat is the execution result?"


def load_data(path, n):
    samples = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            if i >= n + N_WARMUP:
                break
            samples.append(json.loads(line))
    return samples


def load_model(adapter_path):
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE_MODEL, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left")
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    try:

    except ImportError:
        attn = "sdpa"

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        BASE_MODEL, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation=attn

    model.eval()
    model = model.to(DEVICE)
    return model, tokenizer


def build_input_ids(tokenizer, system_prompt, user_text):
    msgs = [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_text},

        msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False
    )
    if hasattr(ids, "input_ids"):

    input_lengths = []

        ids = build_input_ids(tokenizer, CLS_SYSTEM, user_text)
        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=DEVICE)
        input_lengths.append(len(ids))

        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        with torch.no_grad():
            _ = model(input_ids=input_ids)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
    return times, input_lengths


def benchmark_cwm(model, tokenizer, samples):
    """CWM: autoregressive generation."""
    times = []
    input_lengths = []
    output_lengths = []
    for sample in samples:
        user_text = CWM_USER_TMPL.format(code=sample["code"], test=sample["test"])
        ids = build_input_ids(tokenizer, CWM_SYSTEM, user_text)
        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=DEVICE)
        input_lengths.append(len(ids))

                max_new_tokens=MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
                do_sample=False,
                pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
            )
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0

        gen_len = out.shape[1] - input_ids.shape[1]

        output_lengths.append(gen_len)

    print(f"  Avg time/sample:    {np.mean(times_ms):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  Median time/sample: {np.median(times_ms):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  Std:                {np.std(times_ms):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  P95:                {np.percentile(times_ms, 95):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  Throughput:         {60000 / np.mean(times_ms):.1f} samples/min")
    print(f"  Avg input tokens:   {np.mean(input_lengths):.0f}")
    if output_lengths:
        print(f"  Avg output tokens:  {np.mean(output_lengths):.1f}")
        total_gen_tokens = sum(output_lengths)
        total_gen_time = sum(times)
        print(f"  Gen tokens/sec:     {total_gen_tokens / total_gen_time:.1f}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    return {
        "avg_ms": round(np.mean(times_ms), 2),
        "median_ms": round(np.median(times_ms), 2),
        "std_ms": round(np.std(times_ms), 2),
        "p95_ms": round(np.percentile(times_ms, 95), 2),
        "throughput_per_min": round(60000 / np.mean(times_ms), 2),
        "avg_input_tokens": round(np.mean(input_lengths)),
        "avg_output_tokens": round(np.mean(output_lengths), 1) if output_lengths else 1,
    }


def main():

    print(f"Loading {N_SAMPLES + N_WARMUP} samples...")
    all_samples = load_data(DATA_PATH, N_SAMPLES)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Func-level inference benchmark: CLS (single forward) vs CWM (autoregressive generation)."""

import json
import time
import os
import gc
import torch
import numpy as np
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
from peft import PeftModel

os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "3"

BASE_MODEL = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct"
CLS_ADAPTER = "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_deepseek_cls_func/best"
CWM_ADAPTER = "/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_deepseek_cwm_func/best"
DATA_PATH = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data/test.jsonl"
DEVICE = "cuda:0"
N_SAMPLES = 100
N_WARMUP = 5
MAX_SEQ_LENGTH = 2048
MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 512

CLS_SYSTEM = "You are a code verifier. Given a code snippet and a test case, predict whether the test will pass or fail."
CLS_USER_TMPL = "## Code\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\nWill this test pass or fail?"
CWM_SYSTEM = "You are a code execution simulator. Given a code snippet and a test case, predict the execution result."
CWM_USER_TMPL = "## Code\n{code}\n\n## Test\n{test}\n\nWhat is the execution result?"


def load_data(path, n):
    samples = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            if i >= n + N_WARMUP:
                break
            samples.append(json.loads(line))
    return samples


def detect_thinking_support(tokenizer):
    try:
        tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
            [{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}],
            tokenize=False, enable_thinking=False,
        )
        return {"enable_thinking": False}
    except TypeError:
        return {}


def load_model(adapter_path):
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(BASE_MODEL, trust_remote_code=True, padding_side="left")
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    try:
        import flash_attn
        attn = "flash_attention_2"
    except ImportError:
        attn = "sdpa"

    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        BASE_MODEL, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, trust_remote_code=True, attn_implementation=attn
    )
    model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(model, adapter_path)
    model.eval()
    model = model.to(DEVICE)
    return model, tokenizer


def build_input_ids(tokenizer, system_prompt, user_text, tmpl_kw):
    msgs = [
        {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
        {"role": "user", "content": user_text},
    ]
    ids = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
        msgs, tokenize=True, add_generation_prompt=True, **tmpl_kw
    )
    if hasattr(ids, "input_ids"):
        ids = ids.input_ids
    if not isinstance(ids, list):
        ids = list(ids)
    if len(ids) > MAX_SEQ_LENGTH:
        ids = ids[:MAX_SEQ_LENGTH]
    return ids


def benchmark_cls(model, tokenizer, samples, tmpl_kw):
    times = []
    input_lengths = []
    for sample in samples:
        user_text = CLS_USER_TMPL.format(code=sample["code"], test=sample["test"])
        ids = build_input_ids(tokenizer, CLS_SYSTEM, user_text, tmpl_kw)
        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=DEVICE)
        input_lengths.append(len(ids))

        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        with torch.no_grad():
            _ = model(input_ids=input_ids)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        times.append(time.perf_counter() - t0)
    return times, input_lengths


def benchmark_cwm(model, tokenizer, samples, tmpl_kw):
    times = []
    input_lengths = []
    output_lengths = []
    for sample in samples:
        user_text = CWM_USER_TMPL.format(code=sample["code"], test=sample["test"])
        ids = build_input_ids(tokenizer, CWM_SYSTEM, user_text, tmpl_kw)
        input_ids = torch.tensor([ids], device=DEVICE)
        input_lengths.append(len(ids))

        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        with torch.no_grad():
            out = model.generate(
                input_ids=input_ids,
                max_new_tokens=MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
                do_sample=False,
                pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id,
            )
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0

        gen_len = out.shape[1] - input_ids.shape[1]
        times.append(elapsed)
        output_lengths.append(gen_len)
    return times, input_lengths, output_lengths


def print_stats(name, times, input_lengths, output_lengths=None):
    times_ms = [t * 1000 for t in times]
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  {name} Benchmark Results ({len(times)} samples)")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"  Avg time/sample:    {np.mean(times_ms):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  Median time/sample: {np.median(times_ms):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  Std:                {np.std(times_ms):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  P95:                {np.percentile(times_ms, 95):.1f} ms")
    print(f"  Throughput:         {60000 / np.mean(times_ms):.1f} samples/min")
    print(f"  Avg input tokens:   {np.mean(input_lengths):.0f}")
    if output_lengths:
        print(f"  Avg output tokens:  {np.mean(output_lengths):.1f}")
        total_gen_tokens = sum(output_lengths)
        total_gen_time = sum(times)
        print(f"  Gen tokens/sec:     {total_gen_tokens / total_gen_time:.1f}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    return {
        "avg_ms": round(np.mean(times_ms), 2),
        "median_ms": round(np.median(times_ms), 2),
        "std_ms": round(np.std(times_ms), 2),
        "p95_ms": round(np.percentile(times_ms, 95), 2),
        "throughput_per_min": round(60000 / np.mean(times_ms), 2),
        "avg_input_tokens": round(np.mean(input_lengths)),
        "avg_output_tokens": round(np.mean(output_lengths), 1) if output_lengths else 1,
    }


def main():
    print(f"GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
    print(f"Loading {N_SAMPLES + N_WARMUP} samples...")
    all_samples = load_data(DATA_PATH, N_SAMPLES)
    warmup_samples = all_samples[:N_WARMUP]
    test_samples = all_samples[N_WARMUP:N_WARMUP + N_SAMPLES]

    # --- CLS ---
    print("\n>>> Loading CLS model...")
    model, tokenizer = load_model(CLS_ADAPTER)
    tmpl_kw = detect_thinking_support(tokenizer)
    print("Warming up CLS (5 samples)...")
    benchmark_cls(model, tokenizer, warmup_samples, tmpl_kw)
    print(f"Running CLS benchmark ({N_SAMPLES} samples)...")
    cls_times, cls_input_lens = benchmark_cls(model, tokenizer, test_samples, tmpl_kw)
    cls_stats = print_stats("CLS (Forward Pass)", cls_times, cls_input_lens)

    del model
    torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    gc.collect()

    # --- CWM ---
    print("\n>>> Loading CWM model...")
    model, tokenizer = load_model(CWM_ADAPTER)
    tmpl_kw = detect_thinking_support(tokenizer)
    print("Warming up CWM (5 samples)...")
    benchmark_cwm(model, tokenizer, warmup_samples, tmpl_kw)
    print(f"Running CWM benchmark ({N_SAMPLES} samples)...")
    cwm_times, cwm_input_lens, cwm_output_lens = benchmark_cwm(model, tokenizer, test_samples, tmpl_kw)
    cwm_stats = print_stats("CWM (Generation)", cwm_times, cwm_input_lens, cwm_output_lens)

    speedup = cwm_stats["avg_ms"] / cls_stats["avg_ms"]
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  SPEEDUP: CLS is {speedup:.1f}x faster than CWM")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    results = {
        "gpu": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),
        "base_model": BASE_MODEL,
        "n_samples": N_SAMPLES,
        "max_seq_length": MAX_SEQ_LENGTH,
        "max_new_tokens_cwm": MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
        "cls": cls_stats,
        "cwm": cwm_stats,
        "speedup": round(speedup, 2),
    }
    out_path = "/home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/artifacts/benchmark_func_inference_results.json"
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

- 这正好支持审稿人关注的 repo-level throughput 论点——输入越长、输出越多，CLS 的效率优势越明显
